parameter.name: enroll_device
parameter.description: A boolean option that enables host/device enrollment in Microsoft Intune when required by policy or during Hello PIN enrollment flows. Setting this to false disables automatic device enrollment; Intune-related enrollment and key insertion operations are skipped when disabled. Disabling enrollment also disables Linux Hello enrollment because Hello credentials require device enrollment.
parameter.conf_description: Enroll this host/device in Microsoft Intune when required.
